raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: Misread/misparaphrased the Treccani entry by conflating the place of capture (Cascina) with the place of execution. The summary incorrectly stated that Paolo Vitelli was decapitated “nel cortile di palazzo della Signoria, a Cascina,” whereas Palazzo della Signoria is in Florence and reputable sources (including Treccani and it.wikipedia) indicate he was executed in Florence. This extraction error led the Planner to finalize the wrong death location.
